verdict.rationale: Jira exposes REST APIs (jira-docs-1) and community members confirm using them for automation/scripting (jira-comm-11, jira-comm-16), which supports headless/CI-style usage, but there is no first-party documentation of a CLI, CI/CD pipeline integration, or automation-specific guidance, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2). missing for 10: official CI/headless automation docs, CLI tool, OpenAPI spec discoverability, and independent confirmation of full CI pipeline usage.
